artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is illegible pseudo-text. While typical for AI generation, it lacks the crispness of real rendered pixels, appearing slightly melted or blurred upon close inspection.

The physical buttons on the right side of the device lack clear mechanical separation from the casing. They appear to merge or 'melt' into the surrounding plastic, lacking defined gaps or shadows that would indicate distinct moving parts.
The stylus tip appears slightly warped and the shadow cast by the stylus is inconsistent with the lighting direction of the main device, suggesting a slight compositing or generation error.
